clauses.title: Permitted Deductions
clauses.text:
Permitted Deductions
- Unpaid rent
- Unpaid utility bills
- Damage beyond normal wear and tear
- Broken fixtures caused by negligence
- Missing keys/access cards
- Excessive cleaning costs
- Unauthorized alterations

clauses.title: Not Permitted as Deductions
clauses.text:
Not Permitted as Deductions
- Normal wear and tear
- Minor paint fading
- Small nail holes
- Ordinary carpet wear
- Natural appliance aging

clauses.title: Painting

Painting
